reviewStandards.norm: The SAP should be finalized before breaking the blind, with formal records of finalization and unblinding.
Document statistical programming, source traceability, post-unblinding deviations and auditable changes.

sourceRequirements.label: Original SAP version 3.0 / Amendment 2 bytes and SHA-256 custody
sourceRequirements.evidence: Original JAMA Supplement 6; signed publisher PDF appears publicly but bytes and chain of custody are not independently authenticated.

sourceRequirements.label: Independent sponsor SAP finalization log and source-controlled signoffs
sourceRequirements.evidence: JAMA PDF printed February 13, 2025 electronic signature images are not source-controlled system audit records.

sourceRequirements.label: Source-controlled final database lock timestamp and immutable audit trail
sourceRequirements.evidence: Published journal says assignments remained blinded until final database lock, without calendar timestamp or original audit log.

sourceRequirements.label: First treatment-assignment unblinding access timestamp and approval
sourceRequirements.evidence: Public March 10, 2025 topline announcement only proves public disclosure no later than that date.

sourceRequirements.label: Full protocol-to-SAP amendment history and effective-version mapping
sourceRequirements.evidence: JAMA protocol 2.1/3.0/3.1 and SAP 3.0 lead listing does not authenticate every intervening approval/change control event.

sourceRequirements.label: Independent resolution of two conflicting 2024 versus 2025 addendum cover dates
sourceRequirements.evidence: JAMA Supplements 5 and 7 include year conflicts between cover fields and printed signatures / headers.

sourceRequirements.label: Two separately trusted cryptographic source-custodian and statistical-reviewer attestations
sourceRequirements.evidence: No owner-approved trusted Ed25519 public keys, original document byte receipts, or independent review attestations have been provisioned.

disclaimer: No repository file, release timeline, printed digital-signature image or automated passing mock test proves prospective blinding or qualified clinical review. Only original verifiable evidence and separately authorized independent reviewers can resolve these gates.
